meta.name: product-marketing-copywriter
meta.description: 产品营销文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性营销文案生成，适用于产品推广、品牌营销、销售转化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品撰写有吸引力的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for your products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write attractive marketing copy for your products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为产品生成或优化营销文案：先收集产品信息、受众和独特卖点，再产出标题、正文和行动号召，并按需引用数据与客户评价。
howto.when: 当用户提出产品营销文案创作、文案优化需求，或需要为产品生成推广文案时触发。

say.text: 给我的智能厨电写一条营销文案。
say.note: 会先收集产品信息、受众和卖点再写。

say.text: 优化这段文案的标题和结尾。
say.note: 会分析原文并重写标题与行动号召。

say.text: 为环保App写广告语，受众是年轻人。
say.note: 会按受众调整语气和内容。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude creates or optimizes marketing copy for products: it collects product info, audience, and unique selling points, then drafts headlines, body text, and calls to action, optionally using data and customer reviews.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks for marketing copy creation, copy optimization, or promotion copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write a marketing copy for my smart kitchen appliance.
say_en.note: It will ask for product details, audience, and selling points first.

say_en.text: Improve the headline and ending of this copy.
say_en.note: It will analyze and rewrite the headline and CTA.

say_en.text: Write ad copy for an eco-friendly app, targeting young people.
say_en.note: It will adjust tone and content to the audience.
